rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for images and figurative pictures created by language, especially in literary discussion.

example.english: This poem uses abundant imagery to make loneliness concrete.
example.traditional: 呢首詩運用大量意象，將孤獨寫得好具體。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 si1 wan6 jung6 daai6 loeng6 ji3 zoeng6 zoeng1 gu1 duk6 se2 dak1 hou2 geoi6 tai2

rows.note: Use this when stressing how vividly writing or speech makes the listener imagine a visual scene.

example.english: The way they describe the rain scene creates vivid imagery.
example.traditional: 佢講到落雨嗰幕，好有畫面感。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 lok6 jyu5 go2 mok6 hou2 jau5 waa2 min2 gam2

rows.note: Use this for the vivid descriptive technique itself rather than for an individual image or figure.

example.english: The author uses delicate imagery to make readers feel as if they are there.
example.traditional: 作者用細膩嘅形象描寫，令讀者仿佛置身其中。
example.jyutping: zok3 ze2 jung6 sai3 nei6 ge3 jing4 zoeng6 miu4 se2 ling6 duk6 ze2 fong2 fat6 zi3 san1 kei4 zung1
